tool.name: Hodge source-bearing decomposition screen
tool.abstraction: For a proposed Hodge reduction, expose every source group, target Hodge piece, cycle/correspondence map, discharge reason, assembly theorem, and alpha reconstruction; treat the reduction as informative only when every root-relevant piece is discharged by a proved source construction or a proved zero-Hodge target rather than an unproved root-like surjectivity assumption.
preconditions: the proposed route decomposes or transports a rational Hodge source-existence problem through explicit pieces or correspondences
the source category and target Hodge spaces are explicitly stated
an exact assembly/reconstruction theorem or map is identified
structural_signature: root conclusion is surjectivity/source existence for an algebraic cycle map
route introduces graded pieces, source families, correspondences, or categorical components
some pieces may be independently source-realized or may have zero Hodge subspace
tool.operation: materialize (source_groups, target_Hodge_pieces, source_maps, discharge_reasons, assembly_theorem, alpha_reconstruction); label each root-relevant piece KNOWN_SURJECTIVE, HODGE_TARGET_ZERO, or OPEN_ROOT_LIKE; reject the route as non-contracting if an OPEN_ROOT_LIKE piece remains without an independent theorem
guaranteed_effects: separates genuine source-producing reductions from target enrichment, source-category substitution, propagation-only routes, and unpruned root-equivalent decompositions
localizes the remaining Hodge research obligation to named source maps or Hodge-vanishing statements
non_guarantees: does not prove the Hodge conjecture or any graded cycle map surjective
does not prove a Hodge target vanishes
does not construct a universal fibration, correspondence, or source variety
does not create novelty or independent-review authority
validation_obligations: keep rational coefficients and smooth/projective/complex scope explicit
verify every correspondence or kernel is algebraic at the claimed authority
cite the exact assembly theorem and its hypotheses
expand quantifiers to detect a graded surjectivity assumption equivalent to the unsolved root
calibrate on at least one source-producing positive case and one source-category/propagation near miss before reuse
evidence_pointers: Donu Arapura, Hodge cycles and the Leray filtration, arXiv:2103.05038
Donu Arapura, Motivation for Hodge cycles, arXiv:math/0501348
